observations.location: upper-left title, center bands and lower-left body
observations.observation: Title is the strongest text anchor. Full-width wavy bands carry three paired steps and the large right ring; the body is one grouped block below their lower curve.
All four lines share one start axis, even line spacing and strong navy/peach contrast. Word spaces and comma/period forms remain visible; full paragraph reads in order without searching another area.

observations.location: three calf/shoe pairs across the middle
observations.observation: Six navy angular shoes meet six brick-red calf planes. Their different slopes and separations create three step moments; central feet and right pair overlap the blue flow without obscuring text.

observations.location: peach background, blue ribbons, brick-red calf planes and yellow squares
observations.observation: Fine uneven mottling and lighter/darker tone drift are visible within areas intended to be uniform fills. Edges are mostly crisp but the interiors resemble soft printed shading.

Normal-width gothic forms with open counters, consistent horizontal/vertical strokes, distinct syllable clusters and stable word gaps. Title is heavier than the planning Semibold specimen but stays in the assigned gothic voice.
